Package gui

Class GuestTerminalController

java.lang.Object
gui.GuestTerminalController
public class GuestTerminalController extends Object
Controller class for the Guest Terminal interface. This class manages the navigation and interactions for guests using the terminal, allowing them to make new reservations, leave the waitlist, and pay their bills.
